exposure: Newborn random blood sugar levels (at 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48 hours of life)
Newborn glycosylated Haemoglobin at 24 hours after birth
outcome: Structural or functional abnormality of the heart (by 2D ECHO)
cohort: 84 babies born to mothers with Gestational diabetes or Type I or Type II DM.
finding: Infants of diabetic mothers (IDM) are at risk of hypoglycemia if the mother's HbA1c level exceeds 6.5%.
cross-section timing: Maternal HbA1c before delivery; newborn measurements at birth and up to 48 hours of life.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was measured, and 71.4% of infants were appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
